verdict.rationale: Asana is a work-management and project-tracking platform, so AI-driven code-diff walkthroughs belong to code-review and developer tools, not to this product's category. Its AI Teammates, MCP server and GitHub PR status sync deal with tasks and projects, not analysing code changes, so the evidence does not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can have AI break a code diff into focused sections with explanations of what changed and why
